acceptance_criteria: A user from tenant A cannot read, search, export or act on tenant B records, including object storage and task logs.
An import with duplicate external IDs is idempotent; conflicting people/assets are queued for review; totals reconcile or writes remain disabled.
Changed parameters or source version invalidate an approval; expired permissions and budget holds block execution.
Unknown jurisdiction, expired required credential or missing channel/purpose permission blocks the corresponding action with an actionable reason.
Approved bilingual scripts capture structured intent; hazard scenarios route safely; transfer failure creates a visible staffed escalation.
Two concurrent requests cannot commit the same slot; upstream timeout reconciles before retry; false confirmation is prevented.
Known cost/fee/discount fixtures produce exact approved totals; missing critical costs block quote release; signed quote version is preserved.
Required evidence is enforced by job type; AI cannot populate absent measurements; callbacks link to original asset/job and cost.
Replay job.completed ten times produces at most one invoice; payments, fees, partial balances and credits reconcile to the ledger.
Every CEO/CFO recommendation includes source, age, financial method, owner, deadline and next action; empty data never renders as zero risk.
Reserved stock cannot be double-used; physical count differences need approval; submitted warranty and received credit remain distinct.
Entitlements and unserved visits persist through renewals; opt-out stops pending messages; honest review requests are not sentiment-gated.
Role-based training cites approved material; no candidate rejection, pay change or disciplinary action can execute through the agent.
PO/SLA/site rules are honored; unapproved scope changes cannot be billed as accepted work; branch data permissions hold.
A backup restores within agreed objectives; injected prompt instructions cannot invoke tools; candidate releases fail closed on critical regressions.
